body:
`solace --version` prints which build is installed and exits 0.

The package version is always `0.1.0`, so it alone can't tell builds apart. The output also names the git commit the binary was built from, and says when it was built with uncommitted changes. A build outside a git checkout prints the version alone.

It is listed in `solace help`.

Out of scope: the Settings page's About tab, and choosing release version numbers (task:311f185a4d180f07).

**Tests:** `--version` prints the version and exits 0.
title: cli: solace --version
